messages:
Maya (PM): quick question — for the Dedicated onboarding playbook, are we treating reserved pools and burst allowances as a single customer-facing contract item or separate guarantees?
Eli (Product): my vote is separate. customers expect reserved throughput (committed) + a clearly documented burst band. separate SLAs make negotiation easier. :thumbsup:
Samir (Infra): separate is fine but we need to define how burst is charged vs. throttled. current runtime can do soft spillovers but not automatic debt accounting.
Leah (SRE): also need observability requirements nailed before launch: p99 tail, queue depth per-pool, and burst usage histograms. otherwise ops will get noisy alerts day 1. :eyes:
Maya (PM): agreed. proposing launch criteria: (1) reserved pool provisioning API + console flow, (2) burst budget accounting + billing signal, (3) autoscale policy with 95% success in canary, (4) dashboard with per-tenant burst and p95/p99.
Eli (Product): can we make the billing signal optional for early pilot customers? some SOC2 customers won't want data flowing to billing until contract signed.
Samir (Infra): we can emit a non-billing metric tag for pilots. but full billing requires the quota reconciler to be enabled. Plan: pilot mode = metric-only; GA = metric + charge.
Leah (SRE): ops playbook item: on sustained burst > 3x baseline for 10m, auto-escalate to oncall and trigger fallback (route to cheaper model). Need hint text in console.
Maya (PM): nice. for autoscale policy decisions — do we want a hard cap per-tenant or a token-bucket style allowance with refill?
Eli (Product): token-bucket with refill windows is friendlier for bursty workloads. hard cap for legal/compliance tier.
Samir (Infra): implementation note:
```
# example quota config (proto)
burst_allowance: 5000 # tokens
burst_refill_window: 1h
reserved_qps: 50
max_hard_limit: 1000 # optional
```
we should surface these fields in the API and console.
Leah (SRE): add retention for per-tenant burst traces for 30d minimum. debugging needs context.
Maya (PM): action items: Eli to draft pilot contract language and console text, Samir to scope quota reconciler + pilot-mode metrics, Leah to write observability runbook. I'll bundle launch criteria into a one-pager and drop link.
Eli (Product): will do, posting draft by EOD tomorrow.
Samir (Infra): I'll estimate implementation in next sprint planning — likely 2 engs for 3 sprints for pilot-grade features.
ops-bot: Deploy pipeline: canary deployment scheduled for 2026-06-05 18:00 UTC (tracking id: deploy-8942).
Maya (PM): thanks — tagging @Leah and @Samir for prep ahead of canary. anyone else?
Eli (Product): I also want to add support for per-model burst multipliers (some models cost more per-token). can we accept weighted tokens?
Samir (Infra): yes, add weight factor in reconciler. will include in scope doc.
Leah (SRE): last note — privacy-sensitive customers may require burst logs scrubbed. add a privacy toggle in console.
Maya (PM): good call. I'll include that in the one-pager and share the doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/ONBOARDING-DEDICATED-PLAYBOOK (draft)
Eli (Product): :thumbsup: short follow-ups in this thread or ping me if blocking.
Samir (Infra): noted.
Leah (SRE): ack.
